label: final-overall-and-reference
invocation: async (page) => {const sideLinks=await page.locator(".overall-side").evaluateAll(ss=>ss.map(s=>[...s.querySelectorAll("a")].map(a=>({label:a.textContent.trim(),href:a.getAttribute("href")})))); if(JSON.stringify(sideLinks.map(s=>s.map(x=>x.label)))!==JSON.stringify([["Argument from ignorance","Red herring"],[]]))throw new Error("Overall links mismatch");const first=page.locator(".argument .tag-wrap a").first(),href=await first.getAttribute("href");await first.click();await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");const id=decodeURIComponent(new URL(page.url()).hash.slice(1)),target=page.locator(`[id="${id}"]`);if(!id||await target.count()!==1)throw new Error("Missing reference occurrence");await target.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();return {sideLinks,clickedReference:href,landedUrl:page.url(),occurrenceFound:true,occurrenceText:await target.textContent(),noOverflow:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1)};}
